crop.notes: Whole Mitchell article; Allen appears only once, in the second paragraph.

ocr.notes: gist readable but many character errors, especially in the letters and headings

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Charles Mitchell dictated a reply refusing John L. Sullivan's challenge at the Southern Hotel, with Frank Slavin and Tom Allen, the retired heavy-weight champion, present.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Sunday, March 6, 1892, page 24.

facts.fact: Allen was present in Charles Mitchell's room at the Southern Hotel when Mitchell dictated his reply to John L. Sullivan's challenge, just before Mitchell and Slavin left for Buffalo
